title: 我用代码复刻了王国之泪的究极手

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 5 期
scenes.title: 究极手

lines.zh: 王国之泪里，你能把任何东西粘在一起：木板、轮子、风扇，粘出车、飞机，甚至机甲。
lines.en: In Tears of the Kingdom you can glue anything together: planks, wheels, fans. Cars, planes, even mechs.

lines.zh: 可做它的程序员在 GDC 上说，开发那几年，他每天听到的就两句：坏了！飞走了！
lines.en: But at GDC its physics programmer said the reports he got every day were just two lines: it broke! it flew away!
lines.say: 可做它的程序员在 GDC 上说，开发那几年，他每天听到的就两句：坏了！飞走了！

lines.zh: 所以我自己写了一个。网页里，抓起木板，转四十五度，对准，松手，粘上了。
lines.en: So I wrote my own. In the browser: grab a plank, turn it 45 degrees, line it up, let go. Glued.

lines.zh: 装上轮子和风扇，它自己就跑起来了。全是真实物理，没有一行“车辆程序”。
lines.en: Add wheels and a fan and it drives off by itself. All real physics, not one line of vehicle code.

lines.zh: 这期机制拆解，就把我做它的六步从头讲一遍：究极手，到底是怎么把东西粘住的？
lines.en: This episode walks through the six steps I took to build it: how does Ultrahand actually stick things together?

scenes.title: 网页能玩 · 源码私信

lines.zh: 先说福利：网页版直接就能玩，链接放在简介里。
lines.en: First, the freebie: the web version is playable right now; the link is in the description.

lines.zh: 完整源码我单独放了一个仓库。一键三连之后，在评论区留个言，我私信发给你。
lines.en: The full source lives in its own repo. Like, coin and favorite, leave a comment, and I'll DM it to you.
lines.say: 完整源码我单独放了一个仓库。一键三连之后，在评论区留个言，我私信发给你。

lines.zh: 任天堂没公开究极手的代码，但在 GDC 2024 上，讲了它的地基。
lines.en: Nintendo never released Ultrahand's code, but at GDC 2024 they explained its foundation.

lines.zh: 物理分三层：最底下是 Havok 物理中间件，上面是任天堂自己的物理库，再往上才是王国之泪专用的部分。
lines.en: Physics comes in three layers: Havok middleware at the bottom, Nintendo's in-house physics library above it, and Tears-specific code on top.
lines.say: 物理分三层：最底下是哈沃克物理中间件，上面是任天堂自己的物理库，再往上才是王国之泪专用的部分。

lines.zh: 然后定了一条铁律：世界里所有东西，都必须由动力学刚体加约束构成，无一例外。
lines.en: Then came one iron rule: everything in the world must be built from dynamic rigid bodies and constraints. No exceptions.

lines.zh: 旧做法是按动画硬推着走的运动学物体。在物理引擎眼里，它的质量是无穷大。
lines.en: The old way is a kinematic object pushed along by animation. To the physics engine, its mass is infinite.

lines.zh: 早期神庙的闸门就是这样。玩家用究极手塞一块冰进去，闸门直接把冰压进地里，还在那疯狂抖。
lines.en: Early shrine gates worked that way. Slide a block of ice under one and the gate crushes it into the floor, shaking like crazy.

lines.zh: 改成物理驱动以后，闸门被冰块顶住，两边留出一条缝。这条缝，反而成了一种新解法。
lines.en: Once the gate became physics-driven, the ice holds it up and leaves a gap, and that gap became a brand-new solution.

lines.zh: 这条铁律，就是我复刻的第一条规则：手里拿着的东西，也不能例外。
lines.en: That iron rule is rule number one of my remake: even the thing in your hand gets no exception.

lines.zh: 第一步，抓。从屏幕中心打一条射线，打中哪个零件，就记下打中的那个点。
lines.en: Step one: grab. Cast a ray from the screen center and remember exactly where it hits the part.

lines.zh: 最容易写错的是下一步：每帧直接把它的坐标改到你面前。
lines.en: The easy mistake comes next: setting its position in front of you every frame.

lines.zh: 这就是运动学的老路。东西直接穿墙，碰到别的零件也只会把人家挤飞。
lines.en: That's the old kinematic road. It phases through walls and bulldozes anything in its way.

lines.zh: 按铁律，我不改坐标，而是每一帧算出目标位置减当前位置，乘一个系数，当成速度交给物理引擎。
lines.en: Following the rule, I don't set positions. Each frame I take target minus current, scale it, and hand it to the engine as a velocity.

lines.zh: 现在墙会挡住它，它也只能推开别的东西，而不是穿过去。
lines.en: Now the wall stops it, and it can only push other things aside, never pass through them.

lines.zh: 转身的时候，它跟着你转。因为它记的不是世界里的朝向，而是相对你的朝向。
lines.en: When you turn, it turns with you, because it stores its orientation relative to you, not to the world.

lines.zh: 第二步，转。每按一下转四十五度，转完再吸附到最近的网格角度。
lines.en: Step two: rotate. Each press turns it 45 degrees, then snaps it to the nearest grid angle.

lines.zh: 这样木板才摆得正、对得齐。游戏里具体怎么吸附，任天堂没讲，四十五度是我自己选的。
lines.en: That's what keeps planks square and aligned. Nintendo never said how the game snaps; 45 degrees is my own choice.

lines.zh: 第三步，找粘接点。举着的时候，每一帧都在问：我这坨零件，离别的零件最近的是哪两个点？
lines.en: Step three: find the glue point. While you hold something, every frame asks: which two points are closest between my parts and everyone else's?

lines.zh: 物理引擎正好有这个查询：给两个形状，返回最近的两点和距离。
lines.en: The physics engine already has that query: give it two shapes, get back the two closest points and the distance.

lines.zh: 距离小于一个阈值，就画出这根预览线。换个角度，最近点就跟着跳。
lines.en: If the distance is under a threshold, draw this preview line. Change the angle and the closest pair jumps with it.

lines.zh: 据媒体报道，任天堂还申请过一项专利：粘的时候，在两个物体上同时显示吸附点。你只动一个，两边都告诉你会粘在哪。
lines.en: Nintendo reportedly even filed a patent on this: show the snap points on both objects at once. You move one, and both tell you where they'll join.

lines.zh: 第四步，粘。松手那一刻，先把整坨东西平移那一小段距离，让两点贴上，再把它们连起来。
lines.en: Step four: glue. The moment you let go, slide the whole thing that last little gap until the two points touch, then connect them.

lines.zh: 怎么连，有两种做法。第一种叫关节：两块还是两个刚体，中间加一个固定关节，每帧把它们拉回原来的相对位置。
lines.en: There are two ways to connect. One is a joint: they stay two rigid bodies, and a fixed joint pulls them back to their relative pose every frame.

lines.zh: 第二种叫合并：把两块的碰撞体挂到同一个刚体上，从此它们就是一个物体。
lines.en: The other is merging: hang both colliders on one rigid body, and from then on they are a single object.

lines.zh: 用一座木板桥试试，砸一块巨石。关节版会弯、会晃；合并版铁板一块。
lines.en: Let's test it on a plank bridge and drop a boulder. The joint version bends and sways; the merged one stays rigid as a slab.

lines.zh: 那游戏里是哪一种？任天堂没说，只说过一切都是刚体加约束。粘出来的车会晃、会被扯开，更像关节，但这只是我的推测。
lines.en: So which one does the game use? Nintendo never said; only that everything is rigid bodies plus constraints. Builds that wobble and pull apart look like joints, but that's my guess.

lines.zh: 关节版还有个细节必须处理：粘在一起的零件之间要关掉碰撞，不然它们会互相顶着打架。
lines.en: The joint version needs one more detail: turn off collisions between glued parts, or they fight each other forever.

lines.zh: 第五步，粘完再抓，你抓的就是一整坨。
lines.en: Step five: once things are glued, grabbing one grabs the whole assembly.

lines.zh: 如果只拽被抓的那一块，其他零件全靠关节被拖着走。东西一长，就软塌塌的，一甩就乱。
lines.en: If you only drag the piece you grabbed, every other part gets dragged by joints. Make it long and it goes limp and flails.

lines.zh: 所以要让每个零件都按同一个刚体变换去追目标。整坨一起动，关节几乎不用出力。
lines.en: So every part chases the target with the same rigid transform. The whole thing moves as one and the joints barely have to work.

lines.zh: 还有上限。玩家实测，一次最多粘二十一个零件，原因任天堂没解释。
lines.en: And there's a cap: players found you can glue at most 21 parts at once. Nintendo never explained why.

lines.zh: 但零件越多，物理引擎要同时解的约束就越多。我把求解器迭代次数调到一，同一根长杆就成了面条；调到八，它才站得直。
lines.en: But more parts means more constraints to solve at once. Set solver iterations to one and the same long pole turns into a noodle; at eight it stands straight.

lines.zh: 第六步，动力。风扇最简单：每一帧，在它所在的位置，沿它朝的方向，施加一个推力。
lines.en: Step six: power. A fan is the easy one: every frame, push with a force at its position, along the way it faces.

lines.zh: 轮子不一样，它得能转。所以不能合并，也不能用固定关节，只能用转动关节，再加一个马达拧它。
lines.en: Wheels are different: they have to spin. So no merging and no fixed joint, only a hinge joint with a motor twisting it.

lines.zh: GDC 上讲过，游戏里一个轮子由三个刚体组成：车轮、马达和轴，还带悬挂。
lines.en: At GDC they said a single wheel in the game is three rigid bodies: the wheel, a motor and a shaft, with suspension.

lines.zh: 这才是王国之泪最狠的地方：根本没有车辆程序。车，只是轮子、木板、风扇，各自按物理规则凑在一起。
lines.en: That's the boldest part of Tears of the Kingdom: there is no vehicle code at all. A car is just wheels, planks and fans, each following physics.

lines.zh: 用开发者的话说：我们做的不是有趣的东西，而是让有趣的事情发生的系统。
lines.en: In the developers' words: rather than make something fun, make a system where fun things happen.

lines.zh: 说到拼机器，绕不开围攻。它是先造后跑：搭的时候方块只是摆着，按下开始，才连上关节，开始物理。
lines.en: Talking about machine building, you can't skip Besiege. You build first and run later: blocks just sit there until you press start, then joints connect and physics begins.
lines.say: 说到拼机器，绕不开围攻。它是先造后跑：搭的时候方块只是摆着，按下开始，才连上关节，开始物理。

lines.zh: 而且关节有受力上限，超了就断。机器散架，本身就是玩法。
lines.en: And joints have a strength limit; exceed it and they snap. Machines falling apart is the gameplay.

lines.zh: 我也做了一个围攻模式：每帧估算关节被拉开了多远，连续超载几帧，就断开。
lines.en: I added a Besiege mode too: every frame, estimate how far each joint is being pulled apart, and if it stays overloaded for a few frames, it breaks.

lines.zh: 两种设计，目标不同。围攻要你造一个扛得住的结构；王国之泪要你在活的世界里随手乱粘，而世界不能崩。
lines.en: Two designs, two goals. Besiege wants you to engineer a structure that holds; Tears wants you to glue freely in a living world that must never break.
